reasoning_content: The app is installed on the emulator, and the activity `wemove.app.bipu/de.wemove.umweltnavi.MainActivity` is shown as the top activity with mResumed=true and mStopped=false. But `pidof de.wemove.umweltnavi` returned nothing — this is because `pidof` uses the process name, which in the case of a Flutter app might be different from the activity name. The activity's pid is 2662. I'll confirm that pid 2662 is the app's process, take a fresh screenshot, and check for FATAL in logcat.

action.command: export PATH=$PATH:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools && echo "---PROC 2662---" && adb shell ps -A -o PID,NAME | grep 2662; echo "---RELAUNCH ACTIVITY---" && adb shell am start -n wemove.app.bipu/de.wemove.umweltnavi.MainActivity; echo "START_EXIT=$?"; sleep 8; adb shell dumpsys activity top 2>/dev/null | grep -E "ACTIVITY wemove|mResumed" | head -4; echo "---FATAL CHECK---" && adb logcat -d -t 300 2>/dev/null | grep -c "FATAL EXCEPTION"; echo "---SCREENSHOT---" && adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/validate_shot.png && ls -la /tmp/validate_shot.png && file /tmp/validate_shot.png
